Docs.summary: The evaluation payload shared by all upgrade insight results, containing the overall status, evaluation time, and any detected issues. Whenever this object is present the evaluation has run, so `status` and `evaluatedAt` are always populated; the "not yet evaluated" state is signaled by the absence of this `evaluation` object (and by `provisioningState`), never by a present evaluation with an absent status.
